# The unwired list (PLAN-2026-10-metais-v1 §8, "The unwired list").
#
# Each line names a code registered in spec/findings/registry.json, of
# class refused, content or destination, that no conformance vector
# produces yet, and the wave expected to wire it: "<code> W<n>", in the
# byte order of the codes. A listed code need not name a statement until
# its wave wires it. TestFindingCodesCovered, in internal/guarantees, fails
# on a listed code that a vector produces, so the list only shrinks; on a
# listed code that is not registered; and on a code of class usage or
# internal, which internal/cli's tests prove instead. The list is empty by
# Wave 7's close.
